name: whatsapp_troubleshooting_feedback
description: A single employee response to a versioned static troubleshooting guide offered during ticket intake.
lifecycle: Recorded once as the conversation leaves the guidance step. The result survives dismissal of the draft and carries no contact, description or attachment fields.

columns.Meaning: Opaque identifier of the draft whose guidance was rated or skipped.
Stable, versioned identifier of the instructions shown.
Employee choice to report resolution, ask for more help or skip the suggestion.
Instant at which the conversation accepted the response.

constraints.Purpose: Keeps one guidance outcome per draft across retries.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE INDEX whatsapp_troubleshooting_feedback_outcome_idx ON public.whatsapp_troubleshooting_feedback USING btree (guidance_id, outcome)
constraints.Purpose: Supports aggregate reporting by guide and outcome.
